research_premise: E1: industrialization-associated alteration of coevolved microbial ecological/immune support is the fixed project premise, not a universally established scientific fact.
evidence_policy: A–D labels apply to individual model/organism-specific edges, not entire papers or E1 itself. Negative, divergent, or null results are retained; preprint conclusions are provisional. Model output, concentration, flux, receptor signaling, and physiological outcome are distinct.
caveats: This is a reconciliation of accessible source lists and visible Nov 6–19 Scout digests; no claim of complete lifetime chat or library coverage.
Prior Scout descriptions were not blindly promoted to verified fact; recheck original manuscripts, peer-review versions, corrections and retractions before using as mechanistic support.
Some workbook entries are datasets/archives, not journal articles; DOI absent is permitted and source URL serves as the key.
Bibliographic dates are original publication years where inherited; Scout date is date discussed/discovered, not publication date.
The two listed preprint successors are connected to their journal versions and not counted as independent replications.
This file is a bibliographic reference registry, NOT a committed set of causal graph edges or intervention recommendations.

MSE-001 scientific-foundations and mechanism-seed sources were imported from an unmerged PR without modifying its preserved snapshot; they include methodological and official documentation, not necessarily E1-causal research.
Draft 0.2 references include two PMID-only papers; record identifiers use PMID rather than guessing a DOI.
